tool_params.user_goal:
**Re‑phrased Goal (analysis → reporter only):**  
For each of the five protein–ATP holo systems (p17612, o60674, p24941, q8ivt5, q13418) that already have two 200 ns MD trajectories, perform the specified analyses—ligand pocket distance, consensus_dccm, consensus_rmsf, consensus_torsions, DCCM, dihedral_pca, nearby, protein RMSF—using the ATP-binding pocket defined from the KAPCA reference (residues within 15 Å of ATP) mapped onto each protein via MAFFT/star MSA.  
Compute the ten required scalar descriptors (ATP COM distance stats, ATP–pocket orientation stats, pocket χ₁ circular mean/std, mean/std Cα RMSF of consensus-mapped residues, N‑/C‑lobe DCCM mean, shared-reference dihedral PCA dynamics scalar) by averaging over the two replicates and output each descriptor file with a standard basename into `/home/akp66103/.../analysis/`.  
Aggregate the ten descriptors for all five systems into a single feature table, perform Ward hierarchical clustering, and generate a dendrogram plus a robust z‑score/IQR‑scaled heatmap, saving these plots to the same analysis directory.  
Compile a concise HTML report containing the clustering results, heatmap, and a brief literature context, and write it to `/home/akp66103/.../reporter/`.  
All analyses must treat the systems as holo complexes (include ATP, exclude crystallographic Mg/ions), use the default AMBER99SB-ILDN/TIP3P/310 K/1 bar/0.15 M NaCl conditions, and assume the trajectories already exist—no preprocessing, simulation, or HPC submission is performed.
